newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Q4 includes larger writedown.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Q4 includes larger writedown.

text.p: Johnson Worldwide Industries Inc said it increased the fourth-quarter product writedown charge by $800,000 or $0.10 per share since it estimated the amount in September.
The manufacturer of outdoor recreation products on Tuesday posted a fourth-quarter loss of $16.9 million or $2.08 per share. For the full year, it lost $11.4 million or $1.40 per share.
Results include nonrecurring charges of $4.3 million in the quarter and $6.8 million for the full year related to inventory and asset writedowns.
President Ronald Whitaker said in a statement, "Results for the fiscal year 1996 were impacted by a number of unusual events as well as by a softler than expected retail market.

"During the fiscal fourth quarter, under the direction of the Office fo the Chairman, Johnson Worldwide's senior management team conducted an intensive review of the company's operations, concurrently with the board's search for a new chief executive officer," Whitaker added. "A critical examination and re-valuing of our inventory, both in terms of size and obsolescence, was necessary."
